test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the measure of the central angle of a sector if its area is 16π and the radius is 8.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total area of the circle = π × r² = π × 8² = 64π

Area of the sector is given as 16π.

Ratio of sector area to total area = 16π ÷ 64π = 1/4

Central angle = (1/4) × 360° = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of the sector = 16π

Radius (r) = 8

**Formula Used:**

Area of a sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b7d7edc5baa2175e3e5239e1d6283384b7d42ac91a005c153c121811a87e5df.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 16π = (θ ÷ 360°) × π × (8)²

⇒ 16π = (θ ÷ 360°) × 64π

⇒ 16 ÷ 64 = θ ÷ 360°

⇒ 1/4 = θ ÷ 360°

⇒ θ = 360° ÷ 4 = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Length of an Arc

The length of an arc of a sector with central angle θ is given by l = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Sector

The perimeter of a sector includes the arc length and the two radii: P = l + 2r.

Area of a Segment

The area of the segment enclosed by a chord and its corresponding arc is determined by subtracting the area of the triangle formed by the radii and the chord from the area of the sector.
